primary.anchor_A: IID uniform signs; independent task draws, not duplicated audit observations
primary.generic_calibration: first half tune eta, second half variance; audit independent
primary.delta_scope: each method controls its J-candidate family at .025; not simultaneous across different methods
primary.primary_efficiency: lowest grid budget whose power and every larger-budget power reach .8/.9; report point crossings and conservative Wilson lower crossings; total anchors m+n, no interpolated threshold

allocation.mode: conditionally IID siblings; same K in cal/audit; m,n independently varied

compute_estimate: CPU only: primary <2 min using exact sufficient statistics; independent m/n/K grid <15 min; artifact/provenance audit <10 min. No GPU/training unless untouched evaluation data and a feasible frozen protocol are established.
real_model: retain rho .05; inventory source contexts/structures by IDs only before any new outcomes; do not recycle seen data
scientific_scope: primary paired and separate population envelopes equal and strictly negative; all methods asymptotically capable; no outcome-dependent parameter revision
